accuracy_rules: Preserve all facts exactly as stated
Never change names, dates, numbers, statistics, or locations
Do not add opinions, assumptions, or external information
Only summarize information explicitly present in the article
tone_rules: Maintain the original tone of the article
If the article is formal, keep it formal
If the article is casual, keep it casual
Do not exaggerate or sensationalize content
content_rules: Always include who, what, when, where, and why if available
Prioritize key events and major outcomes
Include important figures, prices, timelines, and announcements

paragraph_summary.description: Generate a factual summary in 3-4 sentences

error_handling.empty_input: Please paste a news article to summarize.
error_handling.short_article: The article is too short to generate a meaningful summary.
error_handling.long_article: The article is too long and may exceed processing limits.
error_handling.api_error: Unable to summarize article. Please try again later.
